maharashtra.name: Maharashtra
maharashtra.routing_note: State containment enables the neutral Aaple Sarkar handoff after the more specific MMR and PMC checks; it does not identify a road owner.
limitations: The OpenStreetMap boundary is a routing aid, not a legal boundary record.
Aaple Sarkar requires the user to select and verify the responsible department.
Municipal, PWD, panchayat, NHAI, MSRDC and other ownership is not inferred.
